tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The ground of the tree mark. Identity colour: hero bands, the dark theme's page. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The tree's trunk and branches. Identity colour: type and marks on `brand-navy`, the light theme's page. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-leaf
tokens.usage: The leaves and the root arc. Identity fills and illustration only. `brand-paper` on it is 4.25:1, so only text at 24px+ or bold 19px+ sits on it; for buttons use `accent`.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Sunken ground: code blocks, wells, the page behind raised panels.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the logo's own navy; light is its paper.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface-000`, `surface-100` and `surface-200` (≥8.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `surface-000`, `surface-100` and `surface-200` (≥4.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active states and primary-button fill: the leaf blue tuned per theme. As text it reads on `surface-100` and `surface-200` (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (6.6:1 dark, 6.0:1 light).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning on their own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls (≥3.9:1 on `surface-100`).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px; ≥4.8:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero titles and the wordmark setting. One per page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles and the name beside the mark.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, in the body face: the pixel faces are hard to read at this size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and metadata, in `ink-muted`. Short lines only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags and table headers, set in capitals. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The pixel grid unit: icon-to-label gaps, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls, between label and field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and button padding, gaps between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of panels and page gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The default: cards, panels, images and tiles stay square, true to the pixel grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small chips: just enough to soften a pixel corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. Never round further.
